name: @fhevm/solana-zama-host
description: Codama client for the zama-host program. Regenerated by npm run codegen:solana in sdk/js-sdk.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --declaration --declarationDir dist/types && tsc --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 --verbatimModuleSyntax false --outDir dist/cjs && printf '{"type":"commonjs"}' > dist/cjs/package.json
